classification: Filename-based permanent experimental flag at collect(), not a stale JSON value or Lean compilation failure
actual_unchanged_checker_error: unfinished/experimental source cannot enter the source-assimilated lane
probe_scope: Synthetic non-review values, exact current whole-module name set. The experimental guard rejects before binding/source/reviewer checks. No scientific record or reviewer identity was fabricated or installed.
changed_module_policy: Every changed production module requires a source-assimilated publication record; experimental modules are categorically rejected.
implication: An actual whole-module semantic review alone cannot close this gate while the experimental classification and source-assimilated-only policy are both unchanged.
preserve: Do not flip experimental false, omit the module, fabricate a record, or change verifier/scoring for green.
user_choice_requested: Retain experimental classification and authorize design/independent review of a narrowly scoped migration-maintenance lane, or keep current policy and defer main migration. No answer is not approval.
hypothetical_maintenance_scope: Exact compatibility diff, whole source/formal/raw provenance, actual Lean/kernel/Tests/axiom/trust gates and independent review; no scientific construction/executable/physical/resource promotion. Must have separately approved policy and tests before production behavior changes.
